# Whiteheap

> Open-source tools and infrastructure for agents, developers and security teams, all written in Rust.

Each tool is one binary with no runtime to install. Every release carries SHA-256 checksums and a GitHub build-provenance attestation (`gh attestation verify <file> --repo whiteheap/<tool>`).

## Tools

- [residue](https://residue.whiteheap.com): Reclaim your storage from Git worktrees, automatically and safely. residue removes a worktree only when nothing in it would be lost, whichever coding agent left it. One Rust binary with one dependency (`libc`), for macOS and Linux. Repository: https://github.com/whiteheap/residue. Install: `brew install whiteheap/tap/residue`
